name: Talk Insights
title: Talk Insights
body:
Talk Insights is an intelligent feature within the Notes app that enables users to record, transcribe, and summarize content while talking. During a talk, it can automatically convert spoken content into text in real-time and generate a concise meeting summary afterward.

Availability

Talk Insights is currently available in specific countries and regions. Only certain languages are supported for speech recognition and transcription. We will gradually expand the supported regions and languages based on actual circumstances. Before enabling this feature, please ensure that your country or region is listed below.

How to Enable

Step 1. Turn on Wi-Fi or mobile data.

Step 2. Open Settings > Lab Features > Explore Lab Features

Step 3. Choose Talk Insights.

Step 4. Enable the feature. Carefully read any pop-up notices.

Step 5. Tap "I understand and agree" to accept the terms and privacy information.

Step 6. You can now tap New Talk to start using Talk Insights immediately, or open the Notes app and tap Create to create a new Talk Insights note.

Troubleshooting

1. Feature not visible

Confirm your app is up to date and your device region/language matches the supported list.

2. Low-quality transcription

Move to a quieter area, or position the device closer to the speaker(s).

3. Missing notes after disabling

Check your backup (cloud or local export). If you did not back up before disabling, notes removed from the device may be unrecoverable.

name: BOOX Pen/Stylus Issues – Unresponsive or Writing Without Touching the Screen
title: BOOX Pen/Stylus Issues – Unresponsive or Writing Without Touching the Screen
body:
If your BOOX stylus isn’t responding or appears to write without physical contact, the issue likely lies with the pen itself or the tip (nib). Please follow the steps below to troubleshoot:

1. If the Pen Is Completely Unresponsive

Step 1. Test if your BOOX tablet responds to finger touch.

If the tablet works with touch input, the issue is likely with the pen or its tip/nib. Try using a different compatible stylus to see if the issue is with the original pen.

Step 2. Check the device's screen version information.

If the issue persists even after changing the pen, please check the device's screen version and firmware information. Specifically, verify whether the "Capacitive Touch Version" and "Electromagnetic Touch Version" display any abnormalities (such as showing blank or "Unknown").

eReaders: Settings > Under Device Model Name

PC Tablets: Settings > About Device 

2. If the Pen Writes Without Touching the Screen

Step 1. Inspect the tip/nib.

Ensure the tip/nib is not bent, dented, or damaged.

Step 2. Replace the tip/nib.

Insert a new, undamaged tip firmly into the pen.

Step 3. Restart your device.

Restart your BOOX device after replacing the tip to ensure proper calibration

If the Issue Persists: if the pen continues to write without touching the screen or remains unresponsive, contact our Support Team for further assistance.

Tips for Prevention: Regularly inspect and replace worn-out tips/nibs. Avoid applying excessive pressure when using the pen.

title: What should I do if I see permanent lines on my Boox screen?
body:

To help us resolve your issue quickly and efficiently, please include the following information when submitting your support request:

 

Clear Video: Attach a short video showing the display issue when you refresh the page.

Serial Number: Locate and provide the serial number, which can be found on the back or side of the device, or on the warranty card.

Proof of Purchase: Attach a copy of your purchase invoice.

 

Providing this information will help our team diagnose the issue more accurately and offer the best possible solution. Thank you for your cooperation!

name: Troubleshooting Login Issues with Onyx Account
title: Troubleshooting Login Issues with Onyx Account
body:
Q: Why am I seeing "FAILURE TO SEND VERIFICATION CODE" when trying to log in to my Onyx account?

 

A: If you encounter this issue, please follow these steps to resolve it:

 

  1. Check Your Phone Number Format

    • If you are using your phone number to log in, ensure that you have entered the correct country code and that the phone number is in the proper format.

    • Make sure there are no spaces before or after the numbers.

    •  

  2. Verify Device Date and Time Settings

    • Go to your device's Settings > More Settings > Date and Time.

    • Toggle the "Automatically Set" option on or off.

    • Ensure that the correct time zone is selected and that the device time matches your local time.

    •  

  3. Check Your Network Connection

    • Try connecting to a different Wi-Fi network or use a mobile hotspot to see if the issue persists.

name: Reading Data Syncing and Backup
title: Reading Data Syncing and Backup
body:
You can sync your reading data, including reading progress, bookmarks, highlights, underlines, annotations, handwritten notes, and reading themes across all your BOOX devices. The annotated contents can be viewed and shared on our send2boox websites and BOOX Assistant app. In this article, you will learn more about reading data syncing to the cloud and between devices.

Account, Server, and Directory

1. You can only sync reading data to the cloud after logging into your ONYX account.
2. Choose the same account and server to avoid incomplete syncing or mess.
3. Put the same files in the same directory for your devices.
4. Please refer to the ONYX Account and Server and Language and Input pages for more info.
 
Note:
1. The data on each server is independently stored.
2. If multiple accounts are logged on one device, each user will only see the notes synced to their own accounts.

 

Auto Syncing

1. To auto-sync all your reading data, do the following:
Home Screen＞Library＞More icon on the upper right corner＞Library Settings＞Turn on Sync Switch

2. To auto-sync one particular document, do the following:
Home Screen＞Library＞Long-press one document＞Sync tab＞Turn on Sync Switch

Note: This setting is not available when the main sync setting is turned off.

 

Manual Syncing

1. Sync the Reading Data

To manually sync your reading data, do the following:
1. Open the document in NeoReader.
2. Tap the center area to display the main menu.
3. Tap the Sync button in the upper area.

Note: This setting is not available when the main sync setting or the sync setting for this document is turned off.

 

2. Sync the Source File

Since Firmware V4.1, you can now upload a document’s source file and its reading data to the cloud when switching between different BOOX devices.
1. In the Library, long-press a book, and enter the Sync tab.
2. Select the ONYX account you want to sync with, and turn on the Cloud Sync option.
3. Tap "Upload source file" to complete the process.

Note: Make sure each document is 200MB or smaller.

 

Local Library Backup

Enter Library > Tap Library Settings > Backup and Restore > Tap Local Backup and Restore
Since Firmware V4.1, you can now back up local book files along with their associated data—including notes, annotations, and reading themes, etc.
After the backup operation, a compressed file with the extension .booxc will be generated. You can transfer this file to another BOOX device and restore it there.

Note: Both devices must be running Firmware V4.1 or later to support this feature.

【backup】

 

【restore】

 

Sync with Third-party Cloud

To sync reading data for files in the integrated third-party cloud storage, do the following:
1. Log in to the same account and choose the same server for your BOOX devices.
2. Open the same files in the integrated third-party cloud storage, and they will be automatically recognized in the same directory on both devices.

 

Check Reading Data on the Website

You can enter one of our send2boox websites on a browser to view your annotated content. Please remember to log in and select the same server your device uses.
US/VN Server: https://push.boox.com/
EUR Server: https://eur.boox.com/

 

Check Reading Data on BOOX Assistant App

You can also download the BOOX Assistant App on your Android/iOS devices to check data.
Android: Please click here to download the app.
iOS: Please search for "BOOX Assistant" in the App Store to download the app.

name: Ordering & Shipping Information
title: Ordering & Shipping Information
body:
If you're placing an order with BOOX, please follow the regional guidance below to ensure the best shipping experience:

1. For Customers in the European Union

If you are ordering from a country within the European Union, please visit BOOX Euro Shop and select the EU warehouse to place your order.

2. For Customers in the United Kingdom

For orders to the United Kingdom, access the BOOX Euro Shop and choose the UK warehouse.

3. For Customers in the United States

For deliveries to the United States, you can place your order through the US warehouse at BOOX Shop.

4. For Customers in Canada

Kindly select the Hong Kong warehouse on BOOX Shop. Orders to Canada are fulfilled from this location.

5. For Customers in Other Countries/Regions

If your delivery country is not listed above, please select the Hong Kong warehouse at BOOX Shop for your order. If your country is not listed above, please place your order through the Hong Kong warehouse at BOOX Shop.

BOOX Shop currently does not support delivery to certain countries/regions, such as South America. If you're located in an unsupported region, please contact our Customer Service for alternative purchasing solutions.

6. Important Notice on Import Duties & Taxes

When purchasing from BOOX, you are buying from Onyx International, a company based in China. As the importer of record, you are responsible for complying with your local import regulations and for paying any applicable duties or taxes when your order arrives in your country or region.

7. Device Consistency

All devices sold via BOOX Shop and BOOX Euro Shop share the same specifications, features, and functionality, regardless of warehouse location.

name: Ordering & Payment on BOOX Shop
title: Ordering & Payment on BOOX Shop
body:
1. What payment methods does BOOX Shop accept?

Currently, BOOX Shop only supports PayPal as the payment method. We do not offer invoicing at this time. If you prefer not to create a PayPal account, you may use PayPal Express to pay directly with a credit/debit card. (For the best experience, we strongly recommend using PayPal Transfer.)

2. What happens after I complete my payment?

After successful payment, you’ll receive an order confirmation email that includes:

  • Order number
  • Product details
  • Shipping information (Please verify these details for accuracy.)

If you don’t receive the email, refer to: Payment Confirmation Issue.

3. Important notes when ordering

1) Shipping Address Requirements:

  • Keep the entire address under 35 characters (including spaces).
  • Avoid special characters like: /, *, \, (, ), etc.

2) Currency

All prices on BOOX Shop are listed in US dollars (USD).

3) Installment Payments

PayPal installment plans may be available in certain countries, depending on local PayPal support.

name: EinkWise
title: EinkWise
body:
The EinkWise is designed to switch between different Refresh Modes and adjust Color Mode, Layout, Contrast, etc. You can instantly apply a preset display theme with a single tap.
 

Access EinkWise

Method 1: Via the Control Center
  1. Swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
  2. Tap the EinkWise button.
Method 2: Via the Gestures
  1. Swipe up from the bottom left corner to open EinkWise.
 
Method 3: Via the Navigation Bar
  1. Tap the E Ink Center button on the Navigation Bar
  2. In some apps where the Navigation Bar is not shown by default, you need to swipe up from the bottom edge to call out the Navigation Bar first.

 

Image Smoothing Mode

In HD Mode and Regal Mode (within NeoReader and third-party apps), users can enable Image Smoothing for image-heavy content. This setting enhances image gradients and reduces mottling.

 

High Contrast Mode

High Contrast Mode is designed to provide a sharper visual display when you are using apps.

Tap to turn on High Contrast Mode.

 

EinkWise Code

A new Code has been added to EinkWise for third-party apps. Users can now input specific codes to apply display settings instantly for different needs. You can also share your config with others.

name: Screenshot
title: Screenshot
body:
You can do the following to take a screenshot.
 

Method 1: Via the Control Center

  1. Swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
  2. Find and tap the Screenshot button in the Shortcut Switches.
  3. You can also use the Scrolling Screenshot to capture long web pages.
Note: 
  1. If you cannot find the Screenshot button on the Control Center, you may do the following: open the Control Center>tap the Edit icon>Drag and drop the Screenshot or Scrolling Screenshot button to add it.
  2. Due to privacy and copyright protections, some apps and websites may limit screenshots.
 

Method 2: Via the NaviBall

1. Tap the Navigation Ball.
2. Tap the Screenshot button.
 
Note:
1. The Screenshot button is included in the NaviBall menu by default. Settings on your device may vary. Please refer to the NaviBall page for more info.
2. You can add the Scrolling Screenshot to your NaviBall by tapping the Setting icon on the menu.

 

Method 3: Via Gestures

1. Swipe down the screen with three fingers to take a quick screenshot.
2. You can customize gestures in Settings > System Navigation > Gestures.

name: Scan Documents App
title: Scan Documents App
body:
Note: The camera is only available on Tab Ultra, Tab Ultra C, and Tab Ultra C Pro.
 
Tab Ultra, Tab Ultra C, and Tab Ultra C Pro are equipped with an exclusive 16MP rear camera as the Smart Scanner for document scanning, OCR, and other amazing functions. In this article, you will learn more about how to use the built-in Scan Documents app.
 
 

Step 1: Create a new scan

To create a new scan file, tap the New Scan area, type in the file name and tap OK. You can also manage your existing scans here such as moving, renaming and deleting scan files, and creating a folder.
 

Step 2: Take shots of your documents

Here you can take one or multiple shots of each page of your document, or import images from the storage. Each shot will be stored as one page in the scan file. Tap Next Step to proceed.
 

Step 3: Manage your shots

Here you can manage your shots or imported images such as editing, replacing and deleting the shots. Tap Next Step to generate the scan file.
 

Step 4: Further operations

After the scan file is generated, you can add another shot, perform an OCR to particular pages, or export it to the Notes app or as a PDF.

name: Handwritten Notes
title: Handwritten Notes
body:
In this article, you will learn more about the interface and tools of the Handwritten Notes.
 

Template Hub

Ensure the device is connected to the Internet. Open the Notes app, and tap the Template Icon to get started.

You can browse and download various templates from our built-in Template Hub. Each template includes a preview to help you choose.

Downloaded templates are securely stored in your Onyx cloud account and can be easily accessed under the Downloaded tab.

 

Top Toolbar

 

Full Screen

Note Toolbox: Tap the Full Screen button to access the Full Screen Mode with the Floating Toolbar. The Floating Toolbar contains some quick tools, including the brushes, undo/redo tools, etc. You can customize the Floating Toolbar by tapping More > Customize Toolbar. Here you can add or remove tools in the Floating Toolbar, check the description of each tool, or customize other settings.

In Firmware V4.1, we’ve enhanced the full-screen note-taking experience with a streamlined and customizable Note Toolbox. Users can now easily toggle between brushes or tools preset for different scenarios.

 

Exit

Here you can save your note and return to the Notepad View.
 

Rename / Open

Here you can change the file name of your note or open another note.
 

Brushes

There are 7 brushes for you to choose from. To customize the brush, you can add a new brush or tap the current brush again when it is selected. Then you can choose the brush type, color, and line width based on your preference, or delete the current brush by tapping the Delete button in the upper right corner. Now, a new Pressure Sensitivity option has been added to the Pen brush.
 

Eraser

Here, you can erase your notes using various eraser tools. To switch between different Eraser tools, tap the Eraser button again when the Eraser tool is selected.

Pixel Eraser: You can select the size of the eraser and drag through the area you want to erase.

Stroke Eraser: You can erase the whole stroke while dragging through the area. This is useful especially when you are erasing your scribble.

Lasso Eraser: You can select the area you want to erase, like the Lasso tool.

Auto-deselect Eraser: When enabled, after you finish using the eraser, it will automatically switch back to your previously used writing tool.

Erase Current Layer: Turns the current layer to blank.

Erase All Layers: Turns all layers to blank except the template layer.

 

Undo & Redo

Here you can tap the Undo button to move one step back, or tap the Redo button to move one step forward.
 

Page Selector

Here you can switch between the pages in your note or quickly add pages by tapping the Next Page button.
 

Page Manager

Here you can switch between Sidebar View and Full-Screen View. The former allows you to check content quickly, while the latter enables you to copy, move, or delete pages.

Thumbnails: Displays notes as thumbnails for quick browsing.

Outline: Set a page as an outline or sub-outline to form a hierarchical structure.

Tag: Displays tags you created to improve note management efficiency.

 

Sidebar

Press and drag any icon to create a floating toolbar that can be docked anywhere along the screen edge.

Templates

Here you can customize the background template and adjust the template settings.
 

Layers

Here you can customize the background template, add up to 5 new layers, show, hide, delete or rearrange the layers.
 

Margins

You can double the width, double the height, expand fourfold, or manually adjust margins to optimize your layout.

 

Shapes

Here you can create different shapes and change the color and line width. You can long-press it to select and then adjust it.

 

Lasso

You can use the Lasso tool to select an area to take further actions, including adding a tag. Please refer to the Tag System page for more info.

Smart Lasso: Recognize and automatically select characters or images according to the outline. By tapping the AI icon on the top right corner, your handwritten notes can be converted into text notes and the text contained in images can be recognized.

Freehand Lasso: Select the exact area that you have outlined for more flexible editing.

Rectangular Lasso: Use this tool to select handwritten notes or objects within a rectangular area.

Select All: Select all content across all layers simultaneously.

Auto-switch to Pen: When enabled, after you finish using the Lasso tool, it switches back to your previously used brush.

The lasso tool features a floating, follow-along toolbar. When the floating Lasso tool is active, you can directly drag to navigate or pinch to zoom while viewing your content.

Cut: Cut the selection to the clipboard.

Paste: Paste the selected content directly.

Copy: Copy the selection to the clipboard.

Color: Change the color of the selected handwriting or shapes.

Insert: Add a link next to the selected content.

Tag: Add a tag to the selection.

Flip: Flip the selection horizontally or vertically.

Move to Layer: Move the selected content to a different layer.

Delete: Delete the selected content.

Create Schedule: Recognize and add the selected content as an Event or Reminder to Calendar Memo.

Convert to Text: Recognize and convert handwritten notes into text.

 

Page Layout

In addition to individual pages, you can now use a Scroll Layout to extend the canvas vertically by scrolling down.

 

Fill

Use this tool to fill the shapes you draw with colors. Make your notes more engaging and unleash your creativity.
 
 

Gestures

Here, you can enable/disable various gesture settings to avoid accidental touches by the palm or finger.
 

Sync

Here you can sync your notes to the cloud after logging in to your ONYX account.
 

Zoom

Here you can use different Zoom tools to adjust the magnification.

Zoom In / Zoom Out: Changes the magnification by preset levels.

Free Zoom-in: You can drag a rectangle around a portion of the page that you want to fill the viewing area.

Fit to Screen: Adjusts the magnification so that the screen includes all content of the canvas.

Fit to Width: Adjusts the magnification so that the canvas fits the width of the screen.

Fit to Height: Adjusts the magnification so that the canvas fits the height of the screen.

Fit to Canvas: Resets the magnification to 100%.

You can also drag the slider to adjust the magnification directly.

When the canvas exceeds the display area after zooming, you can drag the window in the upper right corner to pan around the nearby area.

 

Text Box

Here you can type in and adjust the style of the text in an automatically created text box.
 

Insert

Here you can choose to insert images, attachments, links to notes, files or websites, and timestamps.

Images: Here you can insert images from the local storage. Tap the Crop icon, you can remove the unwanted area of the image, and tap the AI icon, text contained in images will be recognized.

Attachments: Here you can insert attachments no larger than 20MB from the local storage.

Link to Files: Here you can insert a link to a file or a specific page of a file.

Link to Websites: Here you can insert an external link to a website.

Link to Notes: It allows you to quickly switch back and forth between notepads or different pages. And you can see history by long-pressing the curved arrow icon on the top menu. It's convenient when you need references or reminders and it helps you to better organize your knowledge.

Timestamp: You can insert different types of timestamps into your notes.

 

AI Smart Scribe

AI Smart Scribe powered by BOOX's latest firmware enables you to handwrite notes in a smarter way. To enable Smart Scribe, tap the AI icon on the Sidebar to discover all the new features.

Shape Perfection: Draw a perfect circle, rectangle, triangle, or straight line. Remember to finish the shape with one stroke and pause for 1 second before lifting your stylus.

Strikethrough Erase: Draw a wavy line to erase unwanted notes or shapes. Remember to cover the unwanted content as much as possible for complete deletion. To avoid unintended erasing, with firmware V3.5.1, Strikethrough Erase will be disabled when you are using Markers.

Lasso Recognition: A lasso will be generated when you circle or frame your notes. You can tap the blank area to undo the recognition.

 
 

Text Recognition: Convert your handwritten notes to text. You can edit, copy, share, or insert them into your notepad.

To recognize other languages, tap the language button＞More languages, and then download your preferred language packages.

 
 
 

Page+

Here you can choose where to add the new page, select a template, and specify its creation source.

From Another Notebook: Add a new page based on one specific page from another notebook.

From Images: Add a new page based on an image.

From Files: Add a new page based on files and the hyperlinks of PDFs are clickable for direct navigation.

 
 

More

Here you can find more tools for Handwritten Notes or customize the toolbar.

Recorder: Here, you can create an audio recording with the microphone. Then the recording icon will be displayed on your canvas. You can add marks to flag your significant moments, play it back, hold and drag to move the recording icon, or go to More > Recordings to manage or export them.

Search: Here you can search your scribble or text for a specific keyword.

Refresh: Performs a full refresh if you find the ghosting accumulates too much.

Page-: Deletes the current page. Please consider carefully, as this action cannot be undone.

Save: Saves the note manually.

Share and Export: Here you can export the file to PNG/PDF/.note format and share the note with others.

Recordings: Here you can rename, manag,e or export your recordings.

Toolbar Position: Changes the sidebar position to suit your handedness.

Customize Toolbar: Here you can add or remove tools in the sidebar, or enable/disable text display below each icon.

 

FreeMark

FreeMark is a system-wide handwriting tool that allows you to jot down quick notes, make annotations, and sketch ideas on any screen.

1. Swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center. Tap the FreeMark icon.

 

2. Name the save path (or leave it as the default) and tap "OK".

3. Then you'll get into "Mark mode" and the toolbar will appear.

4. When you finish your notes, tap the "Save" icon and check the picture in the "Gallery" app.

 

 

Infinite Notes

Our native Notes app in Firmware V4.1 brings a new “Infinite Notes” option when creating a note. In an Infinite Note, the canvas automatically expands as you write, giving you unlimited and flexible space to work. You can drag the canvas with two fingers.

Templates: All five built-in templates also support infinite canvas expansion.

Pin: Long press the blank area to add pins anywhere on the canvas. You can quickly jump between different sections, ideal for long, complex notes or mind maps. Delete or rename each pin by tapping the three-dot icon behind the pin you want to edit.

name: Choose a Book Display Mode

name: System Split Screen
title: System Split Screen
body:
The Split Screen function is one of the most powerful features for multitasking on your BOOX device. Just like the computer, it allows you to use different apps within one screen at the same time. In this article, you will learn how to use Split Screen on your BOOX device.
 
Note: The Split Screen function is not available for all apps.
 

Horizontal Mode & Vertical Mode

The device can split the screen in 2 different directions: Horizontal or Vertical. The Horizontal Mode will change the screen orientation to horizontal (landscape) view and divide it left and right. The Vertical Mode will change the screen orientation to vertical (portrait) view and divide it up and down.
 
 
 

Split Screen for Third-Party Apps

To use Split Screen for third-party apps, do the following:
  1. During the use of a third-party app, swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
  2. Tap the Split Screen button.
  3. Choose your preferred Split Screen mode.
  4. Flexible Split Screen: You can drag the central white spot on the boundary to adjust the proportion of the two sections.
Note:
  1. It's recommended to use Flexible Split Screen when you're using third-party apps.
  2. Flexible Split Screen is only available in Note Air3 C, Note Air3, and Tab Ultra C Pro.
 

Swap Sides

To swap the positions of both sides, do the following:
  1. In the Split Screen status, swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
  2. Tap the Split Screen button.
  3. Tap the Swap Sides button.
 

Exit Split Screen

To exit the Split Screen status, do the following:
  1. In the Split Screen status, swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
  2. Tap the Split Screen button.
  3. Tap the Exit Split Screen button.
or
  1. Return to the Home Screen via Gestures, Navigation Bar or Navigation Ball directly.

name: EinkWise
title: EinkWise
body:
The EinkWise is designed to switch between different Refresh Modes and adjust Color Mode, Layout, Contrast, etc. You can instantly apply a preset display theme with a single tap.

 

Access EinkWise

Method 1: Via the Control Center
  1. Swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
  2. Tap the EinkWise button.
Method 2: Via the Gestures
  1. Swipe up from the bottom right corner to open EinkWise.
 
Method 3: Via the Navigation Bar

  2. In some apps where the Navigation Bar is not shown by default, you need to swipe up from the bottom edge to call out the Navigation Bar first.
 

Image Smoothing Mode

In HD Mode and Regal Mode (within NeoReader and third-party apps), users can enable Image Smoothing for image-heavy content. This setting enhances image gradients and reduces mottling.

 

High Contrast Mode

name: Refresh Modes
title: Refresh Modes
body:
Open the Control Center > Tap EinkWise > Choose refresh modes
 
To balance display quality and refresh speed, we provide different refresh modes to give you the best experience in different scenarios. The refresh rate of each app can be independently set to achieve optimal performance without affecting the system-wide refresh settings. Here you will learn about them and how to select the most suitable one.
 
Display Quality: HD > Speed = Smooth
Refresh Speed: Smooth > Speed > HD

 

Refresh Modes Explained

The BOOX devices have several built-in Refresh Modes:
HD Mode (System Default): For reading books and other static content. It can show the crispest texts with the least ghosting.
Speed Mode: It offers ultra-fast refresh rates while significantly improving display clarity and reducing ghosting compared to previous versions.
Smooth Mode: Smooth Mode is best for dynamic content such as web browsing, social media apps, scrolling-heavy apps, and video streaming.
 

Manual Refresh

You can choose one method to perform a manual full refresh if you find that the ghosting accumulates too much.
1. Open the Control Center＞Full Refresh button.
2. Tap the Navigation Ball＞Full Refresh button.
3. Set Bottom Gestures to perform a manual full refresh.
4. Set the Navigation Bar to perform a manual full refresh.

Control Center > EinkWise > Color Mode > Tap Custom

name: Home Screen and Dock
title: Home Screen and Dock
body:
The BOOX Tab Series devices have a redesigned interface for you to enjoy a unique user experience like on a conventional tablet. The Home Screen is an area to display all your apps and widgets on the device, while the Dock can store your frequently used apps. In this article, you will learn how to organize your Home Screen to fit the way you work.

 
 

Rearrange App Icons

To move an app icon, do the following:
  1. Tap and hold the app icon you would like to move, and then it will show the context menu.
  2. Drag and drop it to a different location of the Home Screen, or to the Dock as one of your frequently used apps.
  3. If you drag it to the left/right border of the screen, it will turn to the previous/next page.

Add/Remove an App to a Group

To add an app to a group, do the following:
1. Long press the icon.
2. Drag and drop it into an existing group or create a new group.
You can also long press the icon to bring up the context menu and tap "Add to a group". Or tap an existing group and tap the "Add" icon.

To remove apps from a group, do the following:
1. Tap an existing group.
2. Long press the app you would like to remove from this group.
3. Tap Remove from group in the context menu.

 

Tidy Up App Icons

To auto arrange (tidy up) icons, do the following:
  1. Long press a blank area of the Home Screen to enter Edit Mode.
  2. Tap Tidy Up, and it will automatically arrange the icons on all pages.
 

Rearrange Widgets

To add a widget, do the following:
  1. Long press a blank area of the Home Screen to enter Edit Mode.
  2. Tap Desktop Widgets.
  3. Choose a widget you would like to add.
  4. Tap a blank area to exit Edit Mode.
 
To remove a widget, do the following:
  1. Long press the widget you would like to remove.
  2. Tap Remove.
or
  1. Long press a blank area of the Home Screen to enter Edit Mode.
  2. Tap the – icon on the upper right corner of the widget you would like to remove.
  3. Tap a blank area to exit Edit Mode.
 
To move a widget, do the following:
  1. Tap and hold the widget you would like to move, and then it will show the context menu.
  2. Drag and drop it to a different location of the Home Screen.
  3. If you drag it to the left/right border of the screen, it will turn to the previous/next page.
 
To resize a widget, do the following:
  1. Long press the widget you would like to resize.
  2. Tap Resize a widget.
  3. Adjust the borders of the widget, and then tap a blank area to exit.
Note: The resizing function is not applicable to all widgets.
 

Advanced Settings

For more advanced settings, do the following:
  1. Long press a blank area of the Home Screen to enter Edit Mode.
  2. Tap Desktop Settings.
or
  1. Go to the Settings page.
  2. Choose Desktop & Screensaver.
 
Here you can customize the settings including changing the screensaver or shutdown image, setting a home screen, locking the desktop layout, or turning on/off Smart Assistant.

name: Troubleshooting
title: Troubleshooting
body:
In this article, you will find some FAQs regarding the BOOX devices.
 

Software

Q: How can I turn pages on third-party apps by using the built-in page-turn buttons or the buttons on the magnetic case?

A: The built-in page-turn buttons or the buttons on the magnetic case simulate the volume buttons in the Android OS. As a result, you need to enable Turn Pages with Volume Controls in some apps to use them to turn pages.
 

Q: What can I do if my device is locked?

A: This issue is caused due to the server update on our end. If you find your device is suddenly locked, please connect the device to the Internet. After that, your device will be unlocked automatically.
 
If you are still unable to unlock the device, please submit a request here. In your request, please let us know:
  • Your order number or a screenshot for proof of purchase
  • A picture of the device (includes MAC number)
  • The serial number of the device (located at the back of the device)
 
Once receiving your info, we will contact our tech team to unlock the device for you.
 

Q: How can I restore my notes deleted by mistake?

A: The Restore function has been added since Firmware V3.2.2. You can do the following to restore your notes:
  1. In Home Screen, go to Notes.
  2. Tap the hamburger menu in the top right corner and choose Recycle Bin.
  3. Choose your notes and tap the Restore button to restore them.
 
Note: Notes deleted before Firmware V3.2.2 cannot be restored.
 

Q: How can I keep my notes after logging out?

A: You can do the following to keep your notes after logging out:
  1. During the login status, go to Notes in Home Screen.
  2. Tap the hamburger menu in the top right corner and choose Option Settings > Backup and Restore.
  3. Tap the Backup button in the top right corner, type in a filename and choose OK. Then wait for the backup process.
  4. Log out of your account and go back to the Backup and Restore settings.
  5. Choose your backup data, tap the Restore button and choose OK. Then wait for the restoring process.
  6. Now you can check and edit your notes without logging in.
 

Q: How can I change the layout of my external keyboard?

A: You can do the following to change the layout of your external keyboard if you find it inconsistent with your typing preference:
  1. After connecting your keyboard to the BOOX device, swipe down from the top left corner to open the Notification Center.
  2. Find and tap Configure physical keyboard.
  3. Choose your physical keyboard.
  4. Tap SET UP KEYBOARD LAYOUTS.
  5. Choose and enable your preferred keyboard layout.
 

Hardware

Q: Can I apply a screen protector on the BOOX device?

A: Yes, but we do not include screen protectors in our package or sell them separately, and we do not recommend applying them. Any damage to the screen during applying a screen protector will nullify the warranty.
 

Q: Unable to turn on the device?

A: Please charge the device for an hour. After that, please long press the power button for about 10 seconds without removing the power source and see if you are able to turn on the device. If you are still unable to turn on the device, please contact us through customer service.
 

Q: Unable to connect to the computer via USB?

A: You can do the following respectively for troubleshooting:
  1. Try another USB cable to check if the original cable is damaged.
  2. Try another computer to check if the original computer lacks the latest driver or system.
  3. Swipe down from the top left corner to open the Notification Center and check if it shows Charging this device via USB. If so, tap it and then switch to File Transfer under USE USB FOR.
 

Q: My stylus starts to leak and write without touching the screen?

A: Please replace the tip and see if this continues. If so, please contact us through customer service.
 

Q: My device consumes power very quickly?

A: Please do the following to check whether the battery is abnormal.
  1. Go to Settings > Feedback > Hamburger menu in the upper right corner > Settings > Enable Save logs to local storage before Reboot device > return to the previous page and tap the + button to submit the first feedback.
  2. After submitting the first feedback, please fully charge the device and use it as normal until the power reaches about 30%. Then go to Settings > Feedback > tap the + button > tick Send Log and send the second feedback.
  3. After receiving your feedback, our tech team will check if the battery has worked properly.
 
If you have more questions, please visit our Help Center or refer to the Customer Service page to contact us.

name: Transfer with Your Computer
title: Transfer with Your Computer
body:

Transfer Files

1. Connect your BOOX device and your computer with the same LAN (local area network).
2. Open the BOOXDrop app on your device and enter the URL in your computer browser.

3. Here you can send files to your BOOX device or download files to your computer.

4. You can check the file in the Receive tab in the BOOXDrop app on your device.

 

Transfer Files with send2boox Website

1. Enter the send2boox websites the same as that on your BOOXDrop App into your computer browser. (If you want to change the server, click here.)
US/VN Server: https://push.boox.com/
EUR Server: https://eur.boox.com/

3. Click the BOOXDrop tab, where you can send files and screensaver to your device in the Online transfer, and you can check the file in the Push tab in the BOOXDrop app on your device.

Transfer Webpages

EUR Server: https://eur.boox.com/

name: Handwritten Notes
title: Handwritten Notes
body:
In this article, you will learn more about the interface and tools of the Handwritten Notes.
 

Template Hub

Ensure the device is connected to the Internet. Open the Notes app, and tap the Template Icon to get started.

You can browse and download various templates from our built-in Template Hub. Each template includes a preview to help you choose.

Downloaded templates are securely stored in your Onyx cloud account and can be easily accessed under the Downloaded tab.

 

Top Toolbar

 

Full Screen

Note Toolbox: Tap the Full Screen button to access the Full Screen Mode with the Floating Toolbar. The Floating Toolbar contains some quick tools, including the brushes, undo/redo tools, etc. You can customize the Floating Toolbar by tapping More > Customize Toolbar. Here you can add or remove tools in the Floating Toolbar, check the description of each tool, or customize other settings.

In Firmware V4.1, we’ve enhanced the full-screen note-taking experience with a streamlined and customizable Note ToolBox. Users can now easily toggle between brushes or tools preset for different scenarios.

 

Exit

Here you can save your note and return to the Notepad View.
 
 

Rename / Open

Here you can change the file name of your note or open another note.
 
 

Brushes

There are 7 brushes for you to choose. To customize the brush, you can add a new brush or tap the current brush again when it is selected. Then you can choose the brush type, color, and line width based on your preference, or delete the current brush by tapping the Delete button in the upper right corner. Now, a new Pressure Sensitivity option has been added to the Pen brush.

 

Eraser

Here, you can erase your notes using various eraser tools. To switch between different Eraser tools, tap the Eraser button again when the Eraser tool is selected.

Pixel Eraser: You can select the size of the eraser and drag through the area you want to erase.

Stroke Eraser: You can erase the whole stroke while dragging through the area. This is useful especially when you are erasing your scribble.

Lasso Eraser: You can select the area you want to erase like the Lasso tool.

Auto-deselect Eraser: When enabled, after you finish using the eraser, it will automatically switch back to your previously used writing tool.

Erase Current Layer: Turns the current layer to blank.

Erase All Layers: Turns all layers to blank except the template layer.

 

Undo & Redo

Here you can tap the Undo button to move one step back, or tap the Redo button to move one step forward.
 

Page Selector

Here you can switch between the pages in your note or quickly add pages by tapping the Next Page button.
 

Page Manager

Here you can switch between Sidebar View and Full-Screen View. The former allows you to check content quickly, while the latter enables you to copy, move, or delete pages.
Thumbnails: Displays notes as thumbnails for quick browsing.
Outline: Set a page as an outline or sub-outline to form a hierarchical structure.
Tag: Displays tags you created to improve note management efficiency.
 

Sidebar

Press and drag any icon to create a floating toolbar that can be docked anywhere along the screen edge.

Templates

Here you can customize the background template and adjust the template settings.
 

Layers

Here you can customize the background template, add up to 5 new layers, show, hide, delete or rearrange the layers.
 

Margins

You can double the width, double the height, expand fourfold, or manually adjust margins to optimize your layout.

 

Shapes

Here you can create different shapes and change the color and line width. You can long-press it to select and then adjust it.

 

Lasso

You can use the Lasso tool to select an area to take further actions, including adding a tag. Please refer to the Tag System page for more info.

Smart Lasso: Recognize and automatically select characters or images according to the outline. By tapping the AI icon on the top right corner, your handwritten notes can be converted into text notes and the text contained in images can be recognized.

Freehand Lasso: Select the exact area that you have outlined for more flexible editing.

Rectangular Lasso: Use this tool to select handwritten notes or objects within a rectangular area.

Select All: Select all content across all layers simultaneously.

Auto-switch to Pen: When enabled, after you finish using the Lasso tool, it switches back to your previously used brush.

The lasso tool features a floating, follow-along toolbar.

When the floating Lasso tool is active, you can directly drag to navigate or pinch to zoom while viewing your content.

Cut: Cut the selection to the clipboard.

Paste: Paste the selected content directly.

Copy: Copy the selection to the clipboard.

Color: Change the color of the selected handwriting or shapes.

Insert: Add a link next to the selected content.

Tag: Add a tag to the selection.

Flip: Flip the selection horizontally or vertically.

Move to Layer: Move the selected content to a different layer.

Delete: Delete the selected content.

Create Schedule: Recognize and add the selected content as an Event or Reminder to Calendar Memo.

Convert to Text: Recognize and convert handwritten notes into text.

 

Page Layout

In addition to individual pages, you can now use a Scroll Layout to extend the canvas vertically by scrolling down.

 

Fill

Use this tool to fill the shapes you draw with colors. Make your notes more engaging and unleash your creativity.
 

Gestures

Here, you can enable/disable various gesture settings to avoid accidental touches by the palm or finger.
 

Sync

Here you can sync your notes to the cloud after logging in to your ONYX account.
 

Zoom

Here you can use different Zoom tools to adjust the magnification.

Zoom In / Zoom Out: Changes the magnification by preset levels.

Free Zoom-in: You can drag a rectangle around a portion of the page that you want to fill the viewing area.

Pinch-to-Zoom: Enables/disables the pinch-to-zoom gesture. (Please also make sure the Finger Touch function is enabled when using this function.)

Fit to Screen: Adjusts the magnification so that the screen includes all content of the canvas.

Fit to Width: Adjusts the magnification so that the canvas fits the width of the screen.

Fit to Height: Adjusts the magnification so that the canvas fits the height of the screen.

Fit to Canvas: Resets the magnification to 100%.

You can also drag the slider to adjust the magnification directly.

When the canvas exceeds the display area after zooming, you can drag the window in the upper right corner to pan around the nearby area.

 

Text Box

Here, you can type in and adjust the style of the text in an automatically created text box.
 

Insert

Here you can choose to insert images, attachments, links to notes, files or websites, and timestamps.

Images: Here you can insert images from the local storage. Tap the Crop icon, you can remove the unwanted area of the image, and tap the AI icon, text contained in images will be recognized.

Attachments: Here you can insert attachments no larger than 20MB from the local storage.

Link to Notes: It allows you to quickly switch back and forth between notepads or different pages. And you can see history by long-pressing the curved arrow icon on the top menu. It's convenient when you need references or reminders and it helps you to better organize your knowledge.

Link to Files: Here you can insert a link to a file or a specific page of a file.

Link to Websites: Here you can insert an external link to a website.

Timestamp: You can insert different types of timestamps into your notes.

 

AI Smart Scribe

AI Smart Scribe enables you to handwrite notes in a smarter way. To enable Smart Scribe, tap the AI icon on the Sidebar to discover all the new features.

Shape Perfection: Draw a perfect circle, rectangle, triangle, or straight line. Remember to finish the shape with one stroke and pause for 1 second before lifting your stylus.

Strikethrough Erase: Draw a wavy line to erase unwanted notes or shapes. Remember to cover the unwanted content as much as possible for complete deletion. To avoid unintended erasing, with firmware V3.5.1, Strikethrough Erase will be disabled when you are using Markers.

Lasso Recognition: A lasso will be generated when you circle or frame your notes. You can tap the blank area to undo the recognition.

 
 

Text Recognition: Convert your handwritten notes to text. You can edit, copy, share, or insert them into your notepad.

To recognize other languages, tap the language button＞More languages, and then download your preferred language packages.

 
 

Page+

Here you can choose where to add the new page, select a template, and specify its creation source.

From Another Notebook: Add a new page based on one specific page from another notebook.

From Images: Add a new page based on an image.

From Files: Add a new page based on files and the hyperlinks of PDFs are clickable for direct navigation.

 
 

More

Here you can find more tools for Handwritten Notes or customize the toolbar..

Search: Here you can search your scribble or text for a specific keyword.

Refresh: Performs a full refresh if you find the ghosting accumulates too much.

Page-: Deletes the current page. Please consider carefully, as this action cannot be undone.

Save: Saves the note manually.

Share and Export: Here you can export the file to PNG/PDF/.note format and share the note with others.

Recorder: Here, you can create an audio recording with the microphone. Then the recording icon will be displayed on your canvas. You can add marks to flag your significant moments, play it back, hold and drag to move the recording icon, or go to More > Recordings to manage or export them.

Recordings: Here you can rename, manage, or export your recordings.

Toolbar Position: Changes the sidebar position to suit your handedness.

Customize Toolbar: Here you can add or remove tools in the sidebar, or enable/disable text display below each icon.

 

FreeMark

FreeMark is a system-wide handwriting tool that allows you to jot down quick notes, make annotations, and sketch ideas on any screen.

1. Swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center. Tap the FreeMark icon.

 

2. Name the save path (or leave it as the default) and tap "OK".

3. Then you'll get into "Mark mode" and the toolbar will appear.

4. When you finish your notes, tap the "Save" icon and check the picture in the "Gallery" app.

 

Infinite Notes

Our native Notes app in Firmware V4.1 brings a new “Infinite Notes” option when creating a note. In an Infinite Note, the canvas automatically expands as you write, giving you unlimited and flexible space to work. You can drag the canvas with two fingers.

Templates: All five built-in templates also support infinite canvas expansion.

Pin: Long-press the blank area to add pins anywhere on the canvas. You can quickly jump between different sections, ideal for long, complex notes or mind maps. Delete or rename each pin by tapping the three-dot icon behind the pin you want to edit.

name: System Split Screen
title: System Split Screen
body:
The Split Screen function is one of the most powerful features for multitasking on your BOOX device. Just like the computer, it allows you to use different apps within one screen at the same time. In this article, you will learn how to use Split Screen on your BOOX device.
 
Note: The Split Screen function is not available for all models and all apps.
 

Horizontal Mode & Vertical Mode

The device can split the screen in 2 different directions: Horizontal or Vertical. The Horizontal Mode will change the screen orientation to horizontal (landscape) view and divide it left and right. The Vertical Mode will change the screen orientation to vertical (portrait) view and divide it up and down.
 
 
 

Split Screen for Third-Party Apps

To use Split Screen for third-party apps, do the following:
  1. During the use of a third-party app, swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
  2. Tap the Split Screen button.
  3. Choose your preferred Split Screen mode.
  4. Flexible Split Screen: You can drag the central white spot on the boundary to adjust the proportion of the two sections.
Note:
1. It's recommended to use Flexible Split Screen when you're using third-party apps.
2. Flexible Split Screen is only available in Note Air3 C, Note Air3, and Tab Ultra C Pro.
 

Swap Sides

To swap the positions of both sides, do the following:
  1. In the Split Screen status, swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
  2. Tap the Split Screen button.
  3. Tap the Swap Sides button.
 

Exit Split Screen

To exit the Split Screen status, do the following:
  1. In the Split Screen status, swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
  2. Tap the Split Screen button.
  3. Tap the Exit Split Screen button.
or
  1. Return to the Home Screen via Gestures, Navigation Bar or Navigation Ball directly.

name: Wi-Fi Connection Troubleshooting Guide
title: Wi-Fi Connection Troubleshooting Guide
body:
If you're experiencing Wi-Fi connection issues (for example, third-party apps are unable to connect to the internet and display "Network or Server Error," etc.), please try these steps in order:

 

1. Test Another Network

Try connecting to:

A different Wi-Fi network.

A mobile hotspot (from your phone).

 


2. Verify Date & Time Settings

Go to:

Tab Series: Settings > System Settings > Date and Time.

Other Models: Settings > Date & Time.

Toggle "Automatically set Date and Time" (ON/OFF).

Ensure the time zone and local time are correct.

 


3. Reboot & Reconnect

Restart your BOOX device and router.

Forget the Wi-Fi network:

Long-press the network name > Select "Do not save".

Reconnect by re-entering the password.

 


4. Check Router Settings

Remove special characters from your Wi-Fi name (SSID).

Ensure your BOOX device’s MAC address is not blocked by the router.

Find MAC Address:

Tab Series: Go to Settings > About Device > WLAN MAC Address.

Other Models: Located at the top of the Settings page.

name: Mira Software Linux Setup
title: Mira Software Linux Setup
body:
1.Go to/etc/udev/rules.d/ located location and create a 58-hid.rules file

 

 2.Then copy the following rules into the 58-hid.rules file

 

SUBSYSTEM=="input", GROUP="input", MODE="0666"

 

SUBSYSTEM=="usb", ATTRS{idVendor}=="0416", ATTRS{idProduct}=="5020", MODE:="666", GROUP="plugdev"

 

KERNEL=="hidraw*", ATTRS{idVendor}=="0416", ATTRS{idProduct}=="5020", MODE="0666", GROUP="plugdev"

 

3.Finally, reload and restart udev

Terminal:

sudo service udev reload

sudo service udev restart

name: My Device Won’t Charge. What Should I Do?
title: My Device Won’t Charge. What Should I Do?
body:
Q: My device is not charging. How can I fix this issue?

 

A: If your device is not charging, please follow these steps to troubleshoot and resolve the issue:

 

  1. Clean the Charging Port and Cable

    • Wipe the charging port to ensure it is free of dust, dirt, or other foreign objects.

    • Check that the charging head of the data cable is also clean.

    • Foreign objects in the charging port can affect charging and may cause abnormal power consumption.

    •  

  2. Charge Using a Computer or Compatible Adapter

    • Connect your device to a computer or a compatible adapter with the correct output current and voltage.

    • Charge the device for several hours (a longer charging time is recommended).

    • Check if a battery icon appears on the screen to indicate that the device is charging.

    • Observe the charging light:

      • If the light is red, purple, or purplish-red, the device may have very low battery. Continue charging for a longer period.

      •  

  3. Reactivate the Battery (If the Device Has Been Empty for a Long Time)

    • If the device has been in an empty state for an extended period, the battery may be deeply discharged.

    • To reactivate the battery:

      • Connect the device to a USB cable and charging plug.

      • Repeatedly plug and unplug the USB cable about 5 times.

      •  

      • Then, charge the device for 4-5 hours to see if the battery can be reactivated. If you continue to experience issues after following these steps, please contact our customer service here. When contacting us, please provide your order purchase receipt and the device serial number for a faster resolution.

Attention: Do not mix firmware files between models. Each BOOX device requires a specific firmware package. Using the wrong one may result in system failure or an unbootable device. name: Note Syncing
title: Note Syncing
body:
You can sync notes across all your BOOX devices. The notes can be viewed and shared on our send2boox websites and BOOX Assistant app.

Account and Server

1. You can only sync notes to the cloud after logging into your ONYX account.
2. Choose the same account and server to avoid incomplete syncing or mess.

title: App Optimization
body:

  2. Tap App Optimization.
or
  1. In Home Screen, long press the app you would like to use.
  2. Choose Optimize.
 

Display

This tab contains some general display optimization settings for the app.
 
 
DPI Setting: DPI means dots per inch. Here it is used to adjust the interface size of the app. You can decrease the value if you find some content of the interface cropped, or increase the value if you find the overall interface is too small. You can also toggle on "Use APP's original DPI" to use the default setting.

Apply anti-aliasing to text: Here you can apply anti-aliasing to text to increase its clarity.
Automatic full-refresh when switching pages: Here you can toggle to perform automatic full-refresh when turning pages.
Cloud Config: Here you can manually search the cloud for the best optimization settings of this app.
 
Note: The Cloud Config is not available for all apps.
 
Reset All: Here you can reset all optimization settings to the original ones.
Master Switch: Here you can enable / disable all your optimization settings instead of resetting them.
 

Color

This tab contains some contrast, color optimization settings and some alternative settings when some other settings do not work.
 
 
Add strokes to text: Here you can drag the slider or input a value to add strokes to the text to increase their clarity.

Other Color: Here you can adjust the icon and cover colors of the app, as well as some alternative settings to adjust webpage text color, webpage text size and embolden webpage text when some other settings do not work.

Stay active in the background: You can enable this setting for certain types of apps such as alarms, notifications, download tools, time tracking statistics to be continuously run in the background.

The V2 Engine of NeoReader is our latest reading engine with the compatibility of more file formats and other powerful features. name: Refresh Modes
title: Refresh Modes
body:
Open the Control Center > Tap EinkWise > Choose refresh modes
 
To balance display quality and refresh speed, we provide different refresh modes to give you the best experience in different scenarios. The refresh rate of each app can be independently set to achieve optimal performance without affecting the system-wide refresh settings. Here you will learn about them and how to select the most suitable one.
 

General Comparison

Refresh Modes
Display Quality
Refresh Speed

General reading

Display Quality: Regal > HD > Speed
Refresh Speed: Speed > HD > Regal

 

Refresh Modes Explained

The BOOX devices have several built-in Refresh Modes:

HD Mode (System Default): For reading books and other static content. It can show the crispest texts with the least ghosting.

Speed Mode: It offers ultra-fast refresh rates while significantly improving display clarity and reducing ghosting compared to previous versions. Speed Mode is best for dynamic content such as web browsing, social media apps, and scrolling-heavy apps.

Regal Mode (Third-party Apps): Designed to reduce ghosting while preserving good visual quality. In the latest Firmware V4.1, Regal Mode has been enhanced for cleaner post-refresh results, though it may cause slightly more flicker. It's well-suited for viewing color illustrations in manga, comics, or image-rich documents.

 

Note: The refresh settings differ slightly between the monochrome and color devices. They also change depending on whether you're using the NeoReader, a system app, or a third-party app.
 

Manual Refresh

You can choose one method to perform a manual full refresh if you find that the ghosting accumulates too much.
1. Open the Control Center＞Full Refresh button.
2. Tap the Navigation Ball＞Full Refresh button.
3. Set Bottom Gestures to perform a manual full refresh.
4. Set the Navigation Bar to perform a manual full refresh.
 
Note: The Navigation Ball Settings on your device may vary. Please refer to the Navigate Your Device page for more info.

name: How to request an invoice for your BOOX Shop order?

body:

In the request form, please provide the following details:

name: FAQs on Micro SD Card
title: FAQs on Micro SD Card
body:
1. How can I find out if my Boox device supports a micro SD card?

You can check whether your BOOX device supports a micro SD card by visiting the model's product page and referring to Specifications > Other Specs.

If the specifications mention "microSD Card Slot," then the device supports a micro SD card.

2. What is the maximum micro SD card capacity supported by BOOX devices?

BOOX devices that support micro SD cards can accommodate a maximum capacity of 2 TB.

3. What micro SD card formats are supported by BOOX devices?

BOOX devices support micro SD cards formatted in NTFS, FAT32, and exFAT.

4. What can I store on the micro SD card?

You can store a variety of files on the micro SD card, including books, documents, videos, music, and APKs.

Navigate your tablets through Screen Rotation, Navigation Bar, Gestures, and Navigation Ball.

Screen Rotation

The screen of all models can be rotated. If your device is designed with an asymmetric bezel, you can rotate the screen to place the slim side to your dominant hand so the wide side can be held by your non-dominant hand. Auto-rotate is only available for models with G Sensor.
1. Swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
2. Tap the Rotate button in the Shortcut Switches.
3. Choose the preferred orientation in Manual rotation.

Search Box

Enable / Disable Smart Assistant

1. Long press a blank area of the Home Screen to enter Edit Mode.
2. Tap Desktop Settings.
3. Toggle on/off Smart Assistant.
or
1. Go to the Settings page.
2. Choose Desktop & Screensaver.
3. Toggle on/off Smart Assistant.

System Bar

The System Bar is an informative area displayed on the top of your device to show time, Bluetooth connection, battery power, etc.

Control Center

Control Center can be opened by swiping down from / tapping the right side of the System Bar. This area contains some quick settings for your devices. You can also customize the Shortcut Switches area by tapping the Edit icon in the upper right corner.

Notification Center

The Notification Center can be opened by swiping down from / tapping the left side of the System Bar. This area displays notifications from your device and apps. You can also manage notifications or perform Clear All by tapping the recycle bin button from the top right corner.

Navigation Bar

Use the navigation bar on the bottom to get quick access to common functions. Do the following to enable and customize the Navigation Bar:
Settings＞System Navigation＞Navigation Bar＞More Settings

 

Note: In some apps where the Navigation Bar is automatically hidden, you will need to swipe up from the bottom to call out the Navigation Bar first.

 

Gestures

Basic Gestures

Tap: To select an item or choose an option.
 
Swipe Left: To go to the next page.
 
Swipe Right: To go to the previous page.
Three-finger Swipe Down: You can take a screenshot by swiping down the screen with three fingers. To enable or disable the gesture, go to Settings > More Settings > Screenshots.
Long Press: To open a pop-up menu or check the properties of files.
 

Bottom Gestures

Swipe up in different parts from the bottom to perform quick actions. You can customize it by doing the following:

Settings＞System Navigation＞Bottom Navigation＞More Settings

 

Side Gestures

Side gestures are turned off by default. You can enable and customize them by doing the following:
Settings＞System Navigation＞Side Gestures
1. Up-and-down Swipe Gestures
Swipe up or down on either side of the border to adjust the volume, front light, or contrast settings.

 
2. Left-and-right Swipe Gestures
This part of gestures is turned off by default. You can enable and customize them to perform going back or other actions by swiping inwards on either side of the border.
 

Multi-Finger Gestures

The BOOX Tab Series devices are available with multi-finger gestures. The current firmware includes the three-finger swipe down to take a screenshot. We will introduce more multi-finger gestures in the future.
To enable/disable quick screenshots by swiping down with three fingers, do the following:
1. Home Screen > Settings > More Settings > Screenshots.
2. Toggle on/off Swipe down with three fingers to take a screenshot.
3. You can also press and hold the Power button and lower Volume button to take a screenshot.

 

Navigation Ball

The Navigation Ball is a system feature that provides quick access to different functions. You can customize up to 9 functions on the Navigation Ball.

Enable / Disable the Navigation Ball

There are several ways to turn on / off the Navigation Ball.
Method 1: Via the Navigation Ball App
1. In Home Screen, find and open the Navigation Ball app.
2. Turn on / off "Enable Navigation Ball".
Method 2: Via the Settings page
1. In Home Screen, go to Settings > System Settings > Navigation Ball.
2. Turn on / off "Enable Navigation Ball".
Method 3: Via the Control Center
1. Swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
2. Find and tap the Navigation Ball button in the Shortcut Switches to turn it on or off.

Note: If you cannot find the Navigation Ball button on the Control Center, you may do the following:
1. Swipe down from the top right corner to open the Control Center.
2. Tap the Edit icon.
3. Drag and drop the Navigation Ball button to the enabled Shortcut Switches.

 

Navigation Ball Gestures

Tap: Expand or collapse the navigation menu.
Double Tap: Return to the Home Screen.
Drag: Move the Navigation Ball.

Customize the Navigation Ball

There are 4 ways to customize the Navigation Ball. You can customize the buttons' display style, opacity, and size. You can choose which button to be shown on the menu or pin it as an independent floating button.
1. Home Screen＞Apps＞Navigation Ball app.
2. Long press the Navigation Ball button in the Control Center.
3. Tap the Navigation Ball＞Navigation Ball Settings button.
4. Home Screen＞Settings > More Settings > NaviBall.

Note: This setting is not available when the main sync setting or the sync setting for this note is turned off.

name: I would like to use a BOOX device as a second monitor, which one shall I buy?
title: I would like to use a BOOX device as a second monitor, which one shall I buy?
body:
If you're looking to use a BOOX device as a second display for your computer, we highly recommend the Mira Pro series, designed specifically for that purpose. With its large 25.3” E Ink displays, the Mira series offers a paper-like viewing experience that’s ideal for web browsing, reading, document editing, and coding—especially if you spend long hours in front of a screen.

 

The Mira Pro series features direct HDMI and DisplayPort input, making setup easy and convenient. You can connect it directly to your PC, laptop, or other compatible devices using HDMI, USB-C (DP Alt Mode), or DisplayPort. The Mira Pro displays are compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux, though HDMI-based connections work best with Windows systems for the smoothest refresh rates.

 

Unlike BOOX ePaper tablets, which support secondary display functions via third-party apps, the Mira Pro series is a dedicated monitor, so you don’t need to install any extra software. Just plug and play.

 

If you're primarily looking for an E Ink monitor for productivity with minimal eye strain, the Mira Pro series is your best choice—especially the Mira Pro, which provides a spacious 25.3” display for immersive workspaces.

name: TOC & Bookmarks
title: TOC & Bookmarks
body:
In this article, you will learn more about the functions of the Contents tab in NeoReader.
 
To access the Contents tab, do the following:
  1. In NeoReader, tap the center area to display the main menu.
  2. Tap the Contents tab.
 

TOC (Table of Contents)

Here you can check and directly jump to a specific chapter or section with the built-in TOC of the book file.
 
 

Bookmarks

Here you can check, manage or locate your bookmarks in the book.
 
 
To add a bookmark, simply tap the icon on the top right corner of the page. It will be indicated by the hollow bookmark icon turning solid.
 
 

Annotations

Here you can check, manage or locate your annotations in the book, which include your highlighted, underlined or annotated content.
 
To learn how to make annotations, please refer to the Take Notes on Books page in the Reading chapter.
 

Handwriting

Here you can check, manage or locate your in-book handwritten notes.
 
To learn how to make in-book handwritten notes, please refer to the Take Notes on Books page in the Reading chapter.
 
Note: Only available for models with handwriting functions.

name: Cannot Receive Verification Message
title: Cannot Receive Verification Message
body:
If you're encountering difficulties receiving the verification code on your smartphone when creating or logging into your Onyx account, please follow these steps:
  1. Go to your device's "Settings."
  2. Navigate to "Date & Time."
  3. Toggle the option either to "Automatically set Date and Time" (for Tab series: Settings" > "More Settings" > "Date and Time" > turn on or off "Automatically Set). That said, try turning it on or off to see if it helps.
Please ensure that you have selected the correct time zone and verify that your device's time matches your local time.
If this method does not resolve the problem, kindly get in touch with our customer service representative, providing your order confirmation and device MAC address.
After that, please also submit feedback via Settings/ Feedback. We will promptly assist you in finding a solution.

name: BOOX has different sizes of e-readers, which one fits me well?
title: BOOX has different sizes of e-readers, which one fits me well?
body:
BOOX offers a range of eReaders in various screen sizes—6 inches, 7.8 inches, 10.3 inches, and 13.3 inches—to meet different reading and productivity needs. Whether you’re an entry-level user or a professional, there’s a BOOX device that fits your lifestyle.

 

If you're often on the go—traveling, camping, or reading outdoors—a 6-inch eReader is lightweight, compact, and perfect for one-handed reading. It's an ideal companion for casual reading anytime, anywhere.

 

For those who enjoy not just reading but also note-taking, sketching, and light browsing, the 10.3-inch screen offers a more spacious and versatile interface. It's a great balance between portability and productivity.

 

If you're working with A4-size documents, such as PDFs or academic papers, the 13.3-inch eReader is the best match. It allows you to view full-size pages without zooming, making reading and annotating large files much more comfortable and efficient.

 

To help you choose the right BOOX ePaper tablet for your needs, check out the video below.

 

Each size in the BOOX lineup serves a unique purpose—choose the one that complements your reading or working style.

name: Adjust PDF and Similar
title: Adjust PDF and Similar
body:
In this article, you will learn how to adjust the layout of fixed formats, including PDF, DJVU, CBR, CBZ, PPT, PPTX, etc. You can get a tailored reading experience via settings in the Style tab and Layout tab within NeoReader.

 

 

PDF Reading Theme

In Firmware V4.1, there are five PDF reading themes in NeoReader: Original, Clear View, Scrolling View, Dual-Page View, and Customize. Users can switch between different reading themes with one tap based on their needs.

Original: Displays the PDF in its original layout, preserving original margins and formatting.

Clear View: Slightly adjusts the layout and margins to optimize readability.

Scrolling View: Displays pages in a continuous vertical column. Connecting your device with a mouse, you can scroll with the scroll wheel.

Dual-Page View: Display two pages side by side.

Customize: You can define and save your preferred reading settings.

 

Enhance Text/Image

You can drag the slider or enter a value to bolden or enhance the text and the dark tones of the image.

 

Zoom

You can customize your reading view by choosing from various zoom modes or adjusting the zoom manually.

1. Zoom Mode

Style tab >Select a reading theme > Zoom Mode

Fit to Screen: Automatically crops the view to fit the full page.

Fit to Width: Automatically crops the view to fit the screen width.

Original: Display the PDF in its original layout.

2. Manual Zoom

Pinch-to-zoom: Tap the Gestures icon in the Floating Toolbar > Enable Pinch-to-zoom. You can now use two fingers to zoom in/out.

Marquee Zoom: Tap the Marquee Zoom icon in the Floating Toolbar >Select a specific area to zoom in.

 

Layout

In Firmware V4.1, the Layout tab within NeoReader appears only when you are reading fixed layout formats like PDF. You can choose different modes or reflow to get a better reading experience. Customize each setting by tapping each mode or reflow again.

Original: This mode is designed for documents that are already clear and have well-balanced page margins.

Extract Text: This mode is designed for text-dense documents such as journals, academic papers, and newspapers.

Comic Mode: This mode is designed for comic or manga files read from right to left.

Article Mode: This mode is designed for articles with more than one column on a page.

Crop/Custom: Here you can customize your subpage division settings, such as pages, blocks, or reading order.

Note: You may need to try different modes or fine-tune the settings to find the best fit for your specific document.

 

PDF OCR

OCR works in the background while you read PDFs, so you can continue turning pages and annotating without any wait. With Firmware V4.1, Crop OCR has been added alongside the original Page OCR. OCR any selected area without a full-page scan. Extract exactly what you need and then copy, translate, or share the result instantly. Perfect for scanned books, charts, or images with embedded text.
Online/Offline: Online recognition, limited to English and Chinese, provides higher accuracy with a daily quota of 300 pages. Offline recognition supports 30+ languages with no page limit.
Format: You can choose the horizontal or vertical layout.
Page Count: You can select the start and end pages for recognition.

name: NeoBrowser
title: NeoBrowser
body:
BOOX NeoBrowser is specially developed for BOOX devices. The Full-Screen Mode, font size adjustment and more tools enable an all-new instant browsing experience on E Ink displays. In this article, you will learn more about the features of NeoBrowser.
 
 

Font Size Adjustments

Here you can tap to adjust the font size by preset levels conveniently from the menu bar.
 

Full-Screen Mode

Full-Screen Mode offers a minimalistic view that eliminates almost all distractions while you read an article or try to work online.
 

Page Visibility Enhancement

Here you can enhance the visibility for web page display on E Ink devices.
 
To toggle on / off page visibility enhancement, do the following:
  1. In NeoBrowser, tap the kebab menu in the upper right corner.
  2. Choose "Page Visibility Enhanced".
 

Integrated Dictionary

In NeoBrowser, you can use the built-in dictionary app to quickly look up a word.
 
To use the built-in dictionary app, do the following:
  1. In NeoBrowser, long press a word to select it.
  2. Tap the Dictionary button.
  3. Then you can also switch to different dictionaries in the popup window.

name: Screensaver
title: Screensaver
body:
In this article, you will learn how to set the screensaver and shutdown image for your BOOX Tab Series device.
 

Screensaver

In Home Screen, go to Settings > Desktop & Screensaver > Screensaver. Here you can set different kinds of screensavers when the device is in sleep mode.
 
Image Screensaver: Here you can select one or multiple images as the screensaver. When multiple images are selected, the screensaver will be shown in carousel format. You can tap Select Images to choose the images from Local, System, Cloud, and Push.
Memo Screensaver: It will show the memo of today in the Calendar Memo app as the screensaver.
Clock Screensaver: It will show the time and date as the screensaver.
Transparent Screensaver: It will keep the current screen as the screensaver, especially useful when you need to keep the current screen for a prolonged period. But please beware of protecting your personal information when using this function.
 
Monthly Calendar Screensaver: It will show the time, battery status, date, and monthly calendar as the screensaver. You can switch between the light theme and the dark theme.
 
 
Note:
  1. The auto shutdown function will not be activated if your screensaver contains the clock.
  2. Monthly Calendar Screensaver is only available in some models.
 

Shutdown Image

In Home Screen, go to Settings > Desktop & Screensaver > Power off. Here you can customize your shutdown image when the device is powered off.

name: Book Progress
title: Book Progress
body:
In this article, you will learn more about how to check the progress of reading, jump to a specific page, use Text-to-Speech and more settings. All of them are in the Progress tab at the bottom of NeoReader.
 
To access the Progress tab, do the following:
  1. In NeoReader, tap the center area to display the main menu.
  2. Tap the Progress tab.
 
 
Here you can jump to a specific page by dragging the slider, tapping the Previous Chapter / Next Chapter button, or typing in a page number.
 
And you can use more features in this tab:
 
Prev View & Next View: Here you can tap the Prev View button to move one step back to the previously viewed page, or tap the Next View button to move forward to the currently viewed page again. These functions are especially useful when you need to read between two, or even multiple, specific pages repeatedly.
Text-to-Speech (TTS): Here you can use the TTS service by Google, Baidu or other engines with your preferred settings.
Auto Page-Turn: Here you can use the Auto Page-Turn function with your preferred settings.
Thumbnail View: Here you can use Thumbnail View to quickly browse the book and locate a specific page.
Blank Page: Here you can add blank pages in PDF documents for taking notes. The pages you added will be embedded in the document, which means you can export a PDF with your notes. You can delete unwanted blank pages in Preview. In addition, you can also delete added pages by tapping the icon next to the bookmark.
 
 
Note: Only models that support stylus can add blank pages in PDF.
